messages:
maria: CI alert — master integrations are red against Hosted API. Multiple failures in auth, streaming, and tool-calling tests on shard-4. Anyone oncall? :eyes:
ci-bot: [ALERT] pipeline: integrations/master — failing tests: integrations/hosted/auth_handshake_test, integrations/hosted/stream_ordering_test, integrations/hosted/toolcall_end2end_test (run: https://buildkite.example/abc/123)
kevin: can you paste the failing logs or the test output?
maria: quick snippets below from the shard run:
```
auth_handshake_test: got 401 from hosted-auth-proxy: "invalid session token"
stream_ordering_test: stream closed mid-response, assembled chunks out of order (expected seq 1..N got 1,3,2)
toolcall_end2end_test: upstream 502 when calling /v1/tools/execute, body: {"error":"gateway timeout"}
```
janelle: fyi we merged a token expiry change yesterday (PR #8742) that tightened auth proxy refresh -> could be related. cc @ryan
ryan: I can take a quick bisect. Will try to run only the failing shard first. Someone requeue shard-4 only?
maria: please only rerun shard-4, do not full-suite. buildkite job id is 98765 — rerun shard-4 would be ideal.
kevin: also seeing a schema validation error in the toolcall test (might be separate): test expects `result.code` but service returned `tool_result.code`. Snapshot mismatch.
maria: hmm — that sounds like a wire-level change in the tool runner. Do we have any recent deploys to hosted-runtime that could change the response shape?
janelle: not that I recall in the last 24h, but there was a small rollback/patch on the tool-runner service ~6h ago. I'll check deployment logs.
ryan: kicking off a bisect run across commits (range: 3af1..HEAD) limited to integrations/hosted/* — command: `scripts/ci-bisect --shard=4 --tests=integrations/hosted` — will post the bisect job id in a minute.
buildkite: [Queued] rebuild 98765 (shard-4) — https://buildkite.example/abc/98765 — started by @ryan
kevin: quick repro locally: curl to hosted-auth-proxy returns 401 unless I set `X-Session-Rotation: 1`. Logs show the proxy rejecting tokens without the new rotation header. Might be a client-side header missing in tests.
maria: that aligns with the PR janelle mentioned. Tests might be running against an older client lib that doesn't set the header. Can we run the tests with the new integration test env var to mimic production token rotation?
janelle: let's not do a schema relaxation hotfix yet. If bisect points to the PR, we either revert or push a test-client update. If it's the runtime service, we can patch that faster.
ryan: bisect job started: bisect-3221. Running narrowed commits now. ETA ~20m.
maria: i'm going to tail hosted-auth-proxy logs for 401 spikes: https://logs.example/hosted-auth-proxy?q=401&from=now-1h — saw spike at 2024-05-02T03:14Z per initial glance.
kevin: noted. I'll grep tool-runner release logs for any change to response shape. If I find `tool_result` -> `result` rename, i'll call it out.
janelle: plan for now: (1) rerun shard-4 (in progress), (2) bisect commit range if rerun fails, (3) check auth-proxy deploys and tool-runner release. Assignments: ryan bisect + rerun, kevin investigate tool schema, maria watch auth logs. Back in 30. :thumbsup:
ryan: update: bisect-3221 hit a red at commit 3b7f8 and green at 3aff0 — bisect narrowing to 3b6..3b8. Will report the suspect commit when finished.
maria: thanks — keeping incident page: https://go/reports/incidents/2024-05-hosted-integ-auth-stream (adding notes)
kevin: quick find — tool-runner v2.4.1 added `tool_result` wrapper in release 2024-05-01 02:30 UTC, matches timing. I think tests are running against a client that's not patched.
janelle: that's consistent: tool-runner changed shape, auth-proxy tightened rotation, both patches landed in last 24h. Likely a coordination gap.
maria: ok new action: patch test client in CI to accept both `result` and `tool_result` aliases, and add env flag to emulate rotation header. I'll open a tiny PR and tag eng-oncall for fast review.
ryan: bisect finished — culprit commit is 3b7f8d (merge of PR #8742). Confirmed red after that commit.
kevin: putting a short-term CI shim makes sense. janelle, do we want to revert PR or opt for test shim?
janelle: prefer test shim + client update then a proper follow-up to coordinate deploy+tests. Revert would be heavier.
maria: PR opened: r/integration/ci-accept-tool-alias-172903 (small change in test harness). Requesting quick review.
ryan: rerun shard passed after applying client shim locally; pushing small change to CI now.
kevin: once CI green we should run a full smoke to ensure no other surprises.
maria: agreed. I'll mark the incident resolved after smoke passes and file a postmortem note about deploy/test coupling. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
